passage.title: Reading Part 1 - Test 05
passage.text:
TEXT A - Course Announcement

Professional Photography Workshop

Learn fundamental photography techniques from industry experts. This intensive two-day workshop covers composition, lighting, and editing. Limited to 15 participants to ensure personalized attention. Early bird discount available until May 1st.

TEXT B - Office Memo

From: HR Department
Subject: Remote Work Policy Update

We are implementing a new hybrid work policy. Employees can work remotely up to three days per week, subject to manager approval. This flexible arrangement aims to improve work-life balance. Please submit your preferred schedule by Friday.

TEXT C - Online Review

TechNova Wireless Earbuds ★★★★★

These earbuds deliver exceptional sound quality at an affordable price. The noise cancellation is impressive and battery life is outstanding - lasting over 24 hours. The design is sleek and comfortable for extended wear. Highly recommend!
